crossRefs.note: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light…
He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
“Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where…
“ ‘ “For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your…
to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied…

translations.web: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
translations.bsb: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
translations.kjv: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
translations.asv: Redeem me from the oppression of man: So will I observe thy precepts.
